benmore delete-file <path> [--app NAME] [--env dev|prod] - remove a file from the deployed app. Refuses a static/ module another script still imports, or a partial a page still includes, naming those files (api(at:"frontend") compile_errors). Auto-commits to per-app git; revert via `benmore git revert`. Idempotent at the tool level (existed:false on a second call is still ok:true; the CLI exits not-found). The delete_file answer says `reload: queued` (it confirms the delete, not the reload), and `benmore delete-file` of a file the app loads (a flow, page, migration or configuration file) waits for the reload and reports it as push does: `✓ <app> reloaded without the deleted file`, or the reload error and exit 1 when the app rejected it or stopped answering.

benmore integrity-check <app>              - runs PRAGMA integrity_check (read-only, safe alongside live traffic). Returns {ok: true, result: ['ok']} when the DB is fine, or a list of structural errors.

benmore restore <app> [--env dev|prod]     - lists .benmore/backups/ entries with verdicts (size, integrity, age). Pre-migrate snapshots come from starts that changed the schema, ran a new release or changed the storage configuration (the newest 3; startup_checks); scheduled-* backups appear when app.yaml backup: is set.

benmore restore <app> --from <name>.db [--env dev|prod] - restores a validated backup after stopping the app. DESTRUCTIVE: later rows are lost. The replaced database is preserved under .benmore/backups/before-restore-<id>/data.db; success means the restarted app was verified.

benmore git log <app> [--limit N] [--env dev|prod] - the commits of the instance's source history (--limit defaults to 50, at most 200). `benmore git show <app> <sha>` prints one commit's diff; `benmore git revert <app> <sha>` makes the app's files match that commit, recorded as a new commit on top, and reloads the app. Database rows are not rolled back.
